content:
incident-bot: Paging eng-oncall: tenant=Kythera in dedicated-usw2 pool showing sustained queue growth + tail latency. Alert: generate_v2 errors rising (5%), queue_size>600, 95th latency=1.8s. Auto-fallback to smaller model triggered twice. Severity: P2.

Tara: seeing the same in dashboards. queue spike started ~10:02 UTC. Kythera traffic looks very bursty — lots of short prompts with long outputs.

Liam: pulling tenant metrics now. run: `kubectl logs -l tenant=kythera -n inference | grep queue_size -m 50`

Tara: output snippet:
```
# kythera queue snapshot
{"ts": 2109876400, "queue_size": 48, "avg_wait_ms": 120}
{"ts": 2109876500, "queue_size": 180, "avg_wait_ms": 650}
{"ts": 2109876540, "queue_size": 612, "avg_wait_ms": 1200}
```

Samir: this is classic fragmentation — many requests small prompt + big max_tokens inflating batch sizing. The scheduler's per-tenant cap is too low for these long-output jobs. Current knobs: `scheduler.max_batch_tokens`=4096 for tenant, global=16384.

Jules: customer CSM is on call with Kythera support right now. They want ETA for mitigation and whether we'll throttle or tune.

Tara: options: (1) increase tenant `max_batch_tokens` to 8192 (reduce number of batches, fewer grpc calls), (2) enable aggressive prefix coalescing, (3) set temporary per-tenant request-rate cap to shed non-critical traffic. I prefer 1+monitor.

Liam: +1. low risk if we can canary it for 5-10min. rollback easy. I'll stage a patch to the tenant config.

Tara: plan: apply transient config change to Kythera scheduler, monitor metrics for 10m, if queue_size drops and error rate falls, keep for 1h then follow up with ops team for longer-term. Notify CSM.

Liam: applying now. patch:
```
PATCH /api/internal/v1/tenants/kythera/config
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "scheduler": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 8192,
    "burst_window_ms": 300,
    "enable_prefix_coalesce": true
  },
  "__meta": { "applied_by": "liam", "ttl_min": 10 }
}
```

deploy-bot: config-change accepted: kythera/scheduler updated by liam @ 2109876620. rollout: immediate per-tenant override.

Liam: patch returned ok. checking queue metrics...

Tara: quick check: `curl -s http://metrics.internal/tenants/kythera | jq .` -> `{"queue_size": 220, "avg_wait_ms": 420, "error_rate": 0.8}`

Samir: tail latency down to 720ms on 95th. errors falling. Looks promising.

Jules: told Kythera CSM: "We've applied a temporary scheduling tweak to reduce request fragmentation and tail latency. Monitoring now; will update in 10 minutes." They appreciated quick action. :thumbsup:

Tara: okay keep 10m observation. Also add a short-term shed policy to avoid a similar recurrence from background jobs. I'll enqueue a follow-up ticket.

Kevin: I'm taking handoff in 20m for the night shift. Can you add runbook notes + rollback instructions?

Liam: created INC-2345 with details and runbook. rollback command in ticket:
```
POST /api/internal/v1/tenants/kythera/config/rollback
{ "to_tag": "pre-2109876620" }
```
Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2345

Samir: monitoring will keep alerts on but mute paging if queue_size stays <300 for next 15m. I'll also schedule a follow-up with runtime team to discuss increasing global cap vs per-tenant knobs and a better admission control policy.

Tara: note for postmortem: root cause likely customer-side burst pattern + config tuned for smaller prompt profiles. Action items: 1) customer advisory about batching best practices 2) ops playbook for per-tenant transient overrides 3) consider autoscaling rule to detect fragmentation and bump per-tenant max_batch_tokens automatically.

Jules: CSM wants a blurb for customer post-incident email. I'll draft and loop in legal if needed.

incident-bot: Update: after change, metrics window 2109876700-2109877300: avg queue_size fell from 580 -> 190, 95p latency 1.8s -> 0.72s, error_rate 5% -> 0.7%. No further escalations.

Kevin: thanks team — I'll watch the night and escalate if anything pops back. Leaving notes in INC-2345.

Tara: great job. Samir/Liam, please add config diff to the ticket and schedule a 1hr follow-up tomorrow to decide permanent settings.

Samir: will do.

Liam: dropping a small log excerpt for the record:
```
[2109876621] PATCH kythera scheduler -> max_batch_tokens=8192
[2109876630] queued requests coalesced into larger batches -> worker utilization improved
[2109876660] error_rate fallback cleared
```

Jules: marking CSM updated. Closing loop once follow-up complete. :white_check_mark:
